entries.zh: 耄耋；年事极高、衰迈之人（约八九十岁）

old man of sixty years; sexagenarian elder
old man
entries.notes: 汉字栏作“鰲人”，字形罕见且与闽南音写 guân 难以对合，疑为俗写或误读；释义从西语词头 Viejo 取“老人”。

entries.en: old man; aged person

entries.zh: 老大；年最长者；首领、头目

aged-looking; old in appearance
aged, old in years
senior in age; elder

entries.en: very old, extremely aged (tail of Spanish gloss damaged; tentative)
entries.notes: 西语释义尾部“alcache de años, obxrog…”残缺无法复原；核心义由汉字栏“古老”与闽南音写互证。
